description: This PHP class 'PurgeService' provides methods for purging employee and candidate data within the OrangeHRM system, including transaction management, dynamic strategy retrieval, and event dispatching.

classes.name: PurgeService
classes.description: Service class for purging employee and candidate data, managing purge strategies, transactions, and event dispatching.

methods.name: getPurgeDao
methods.description: Returns the PurgeDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Returns the EmployeePictureService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: purgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Purges data related to an employee identified by employee number, including transaction management and event dispatching.

methods.name: purgeCandidateData
methods.description: Purges data related to a candidate identified by vacancy ID, including transaction management.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Loads and returns the list of purgeable entities from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: getPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns a purge strategy object based on class name, strategy name, and info array.
